name: Mark One Metal Works
old_description: Want to be updated with our latest projects and special offers?
about:
Mark One Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication and design shop based in Sparks, Nevada. The company was founded in 1996 by Mark, who began his career as a transmission mechanic under his father John. After managing a fabrication department at a Peterbilt dealership in Reno, he launched Levco Transmission in 1991, later selling it to pursue off-road racing and a role managing production for Torchmate, a CNC plasma cutting manufacturer. He established Mark One Metal Works to offer a broad range of fabrication skills.

The shop provides machining, welding, tube bending, CNC plasma cutting, and CAD design services, working primarily in aluminum. It handles projects from one-off prototypes to production runs, producing items such as gates, fences, railings, stairs, desks, tables, doors, fixtures, furniture, hot rod components, off-road vehicle parts, custom signs, and trophies. Equipment includes a Lincoln Electric plasma cutting table. No facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Mark One serves commercial, residential, and industrial clients in the Reno–Sparks area and beyond. Examples include custom railings and stairs for homes, aluminum fabrication for industrial projects, roll cages and lightweight parts for off-road vehicles, and trophies for competitions.

The company emphasizes exceptional design, unmatched quality, great customer service, and unique metalworking concepts, drawing on over 30 years of experience in fabrication, machining, and racing.

name: Market Source Restaurant Supply
old_description: Market Source has provided Oklahoma with top quality food service supplies since 1986. We understand small business and use our personal experience to better serve our customers.
about:
Market Source Restaurant Supply was founded in 1986 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, by Dick Curtis, whose family had been in the restaurant supply industry since 1945. The company remains family‑owned and operated, and Curtis serves as founder and CEO.

The business operates a 60,000‑square‑foot showroom and warehouse stocking more than 10,000 items, ranging from cooking equipment and refrigeration to smallwares and tabletop supplies. It carries brands such as Vollrath, Saturn, Garland, Tablecraft, Winco, and Hobart. In addition to product sales, Market Source provides professional services including kitchen layout and interior design assistance, personalized site visits, expert consultations, custom fabrication, special orders, and nationwide delivery and installation. A self‑service retail model allows customers to walk out with purchases the same day.

The company serves independent restaurants, catering operations, and other food‑service businesses throughout Oklahoma and beyond. Its design team specializes in remodels and build‑outs, and its inventory includes items such as Cambro food pans, Oneida silverware, and Homer Laughlin china.

Market Source emphasizes a customer‑first approach, highlighting its large in‑stock inventory, family‑business experience, and the ability to supply everything a commercial kitchen needs from a single source.

name: Marko Foam Products
old_description: Industry Leader in Foam Manufacturing and Packaging Solutions Since 1961.
about:
Marko Foam Products operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1961. The company has spent over six decades developing foam manufacturing and packaging solutions for a broad range of industries.

The company produces insulated containers for temperature-sensitive shipments, corner blocks and edge protectors for product presentation, custom medical packaging for devices and vials, beverage packaging that maintains temperature for wines and beers, and EPS surfboard blanks that are 100 percent recyclable. Its capabilities include foam manufacturing, CNC cutting for prototypes, die-cutting of custom foam pieces, and engineering services for packaging design.

Marko Foam serves medical device manufacturers, wineries and breweries, surfboard builders, and shippers of temperature-sensitive goods. Its medical packaging protects instruments and vials, while its beverage packaging preserves product integrity during transit. The surfboard blanks are sold globally, and the company also supplies stock and custom die-cut foam for general industrial packaging.

The company emphasizes its position as a global leader in EPS surfboard blanks, highlighting the blanks' recyclability, durability, and performance. It also promotes the use of recyclable materials across its product lines and underscores its commitment to American-made manufacturing.

name: Marmon Aerospace & Defense
old_description: with the people and technology that enable the future from Sea to Space.
about:
Marmon Aerospace & Defense Group is headquartered in Manchester, New Hampshire, and operates as a collective of six specialized brands across multiple U.S. locations and one in the United Kingdom. The group traces its roots back more than 70 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. It is a subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway and Marmon Holdings, with no individual founders named in public materials.

The company manufactures high‑performance wire, cable, fiber‑optic, and thermocouple products, along with custom cable assemblies, harnesses, and mil‑spec kits. Its vertically integrated operations span 600,000 square feet of manufacturing space and employ over 700 people, producing a catalog of more than 35,000 distinct products. In 2026, the group broke ground on a 350,000‑square‑foot expansion at its Hooksett, New Hampshire facility. Core processes include mil‑spec wire and cable extrusion, thermocouple assembly, fiber‑optic cable fabrication, custom cable engineering, and full‑service cable assembly and harness building. The group also provides calibration, kitting, fiber‑optic training, engineering design support, thermocouple refurbishment, and field services for copper and fiber‑optic infrastructure.

Marmon A&D serves commercial aerospace, military aerospace, defense, space, industrial, power generation, naval shipboard, and tactical vehicle markets. Its products are specified on platforms ranging from commercial airliners and military fixed‑wing aircraft to satellites, naval vessels, and ground vehicles. Applications include avionics, airframe wiring, cabin management, C5ISR, electronic warfare, in‑flight entertainment, power distribution, and aeroderivative engine systems.

The company emphasizes its “One Platform” mindset, combining engineering depth, vertically integrated manufacturing, and customer‑focused collaboration to solve complex challenges, accelerate development, and deliver repeatable performance at scale across every domain.

name: Marne Plastics LLC
old_description: From Initial Planning to Final Production. On time. On budget.
about:
Marne Plastics LLC operates a 58,000-square-foot climate-controlled facility in Grove City, Ohio, in the Columbus region. The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding but does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

The shop runs 18 injection molding machines ranging from 100 to 550 tons, capable of processing a wide range of resins including glass-filled and difficult-to-mold grades. Services span the full product lifecycle: tool build management for both prototype and production molds, rapid prototyping via 3D printing, and secondary operations such as assembly, vibration and hotplate welding, and post-molding embellishment. Quality confirmation includes leak testing, dimensional inspection, and automated monitoring through an IQMS system.

Marne serves manufacturers in the automotive, consumer goods, and packaging sectors. A major Tier-One automotive supplier, NIFCO, has recognized the company for high quality, responsiveness, and 100% on-time delivery. The customer base includes large automotive OEMs and a growing range of industrial clients.

The company emphasizes its nimble size as a differentiator, enabling personalized service and a one-day lead time for production parts orders. A preventative maintenance program and ISO 9001:2015 certification underpin its commitment to consistent quality and on-budget delivery.

name: Marshall Dry Goods Co Inc
old_description: Marshall Dry Goods has been a trusted name in fabric since 1944, proudly serving quilters, retailers, and crafters across the country. Our focus on quality, value, and service has made us a go-to source for wholesale fabrics of all kinds.
about:
Marshall Dry Goods Co., Inc. is based in Batesville, Arkansas. The company was founded in 1944 by Hassel Marshall as a dry goods store selling clothing, blankets, and a modest fabric selection. In 1985, Marshall Bentley and his father, Larry Bentley, took over operations, and the business remains under Bentley family ownership today. Marshall Bentley, the current owner, gradually shifted the company to focus entirely on fabric.

Today the company designs, prints, and manufactures more than 5,000 fabric SKUs, specializing in 100% cotton prints offered in 45-inch and 108-inch widths. Production uses both conventional rotary and digital printing methods, supporting a library of over 4,000 exclusive designs with new patterns released weekly. In addition to cotton prints, the mill produces vintage muslins, Indonesian and Indian batiks, flannel, minky, fleece, broadcloth, and quilt batting in 80/20 cotton-poly, 100% cotton, and 100% polyester, available in widths from 45 to 120 inches.

Marshall Dry Goods serves quilters, crafters, and retail fabric shops across the United States through its online store and a brick-and-mortar location in Batesville. A wholesale division supplies bulk fabric to retailers and other businesses, while the adjacent Marshall’s Quilt House provides a retreat space for quilting groups.

name: Marshall Food Equipment Service
old_description: Your beloved KitchenAid® stand mixer deserves professional care when it’s not performing at its best. Marshall Food Equipment Service specializes in diagnosing and repairing all Kitchen Aid stand mixer models, ensuring your essential kitchen companion returns to perfect working condition efficiently. We have years of hands-on experience, and we are factory-authorized, so you can trust that we will repair your mixer according to factory specifications. You can count on us to treat your mixer with the same level of care and attention that you do in your kitchen.
about:
Marshall Food Equipment Service was founded in 1928 in Providence, Rhode Island, and is now headquartered in Cranston. The family-owned business has remained in Rhode Island for nearly a century, expanding its service area to include Bristol County, Massachusetts, and New London County, Connecticut.

The company provides commercial kitchen equipment repair, offering both on-site and in-shop service for cooking, food-preparation, ware-washing, and coffee equipment. Its technicians are factory-trained and CFESA-certified in gas, electric, steam, and microwave technologies, with many boasting over 25 years of experience. Marshall also supplies genuine replacement parts from an extensive inventory and operates a fully equipped repair facility. All work carries a 90-day warranty on parts and labor, and emergency service is available 24/7.

Customers include restaurants, cafeterias, healthcare kitchens, bakeries, and institutional foodservice operations throughout the tri-state region. The company is an authorized warranty service provider for numerous major manufacturers and services all brands of commercial kitchen equipment.

Marshall differentiates itself through its long local history, factory-authorized status, CFESA-certified staff, round-the-clock responsiveness, and a 90-day warranty on both service and parts. The family-owned structure emphasizes minimizing downtime for clients who depend on reliable kitchen operations.

name: Marshfield Furniture
old_description: Since 1944, we have been manufacturing handcrafted, upholstered furniture with quality and integrity in the USA.
about:
Marshfield Furniture has been manufacturing handcrafted upholstered furniture in Marshfield, Wisconsin since 1944. The company was founded as a domestic producer of residential furniture and continues to operate from its original Midwestern location.

The company produces living room, dining room, and bedroom collections that are handcrafted to order. Its manufacturing process combines wood frame construction with upholstery, offering customers a choice of over 75 frame styles and more than 500 fabric options, plus 48 leather selections. Each piece is built as a custom order rather than held in finished‑goods inventory, allowing retailers to specify configurations that match regional demand.

Marshfield Furniture sells exclusively through a network of authorized retail dealers across the United States. Its business-to-business customers are independent furniture stores and regional chains that carry the brand’s transitional, modern, and rustic lodge collections. The company positions itself as a partner to those retailers, providing unique collections and special‑order capabilities rather than commodity stock.

The firm’s stated mission emphasizes operational excellence and zero‑defect production, with a guiding principle that “we want our customer to come back, not our product.” Leadership describes the goal of becoming America’s manufacturer of unique collections and special‑order furniture, differentiating through domestic craftsmanship, extensive customization, and a focus on long‑term retailer relationships.

name: Martech Medical Products Inc
old_description: To be the leading solution provider for every customer we serve. To drive sustainable growth of our business through the continued investment in our people, technology and quality while delivering world class products and services.
about:
Founded in 1978 in Harleysville, Pennsylvania, Martech Medical Products Inc. began as a supplier of high-quality extrusions and molded components. The company grew by addressing manufacturing challenges ranging from the smallest epidural catheters to early hemodialysis catheters.

Today Martech operates three manufacturing and engineering facilities totaling 200,000 square feet and employs over 2,000 people across its East site in Harleysville, PA, and its West site in Mexicali, Mexico. Its integrated capabilities span R&D, project management, 3D printing, tool design, extrusion, molding, tipping, printing, coating, drilling, assembly, packaging, sterilization, finished catheter production, machining, and silicone product manufacturing.

The company serves top medical device manufacturers worldwide, providing concept-through-production services that smaller firms lack and larger firms prefer not to handle internally. Customers rely on Martech for custom silicone components, catheter systems, and other precision medical devices.

Martech differentiates itself by keeping tool design and fabrication in house, offering customization across its entire product line, and integrating every phase from design conception through FDA validation, assembly, and shipping to reduce cost and lead time compared with market standards.

name: Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment
old_description: As a busy professional, you can count on Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment for a huge assortment of products, the lowest prices, and superior customer service from our showroom-based staff.
about:
Maryland Medical Supply & Equipment operates from a showroom and warehouse in Reisterstown, Maryland. The company was founded in 1997 and has served the Mid-Atlantic region for over two decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business distributes a broad range of medical equipment and supplies through both a physical showroom and an online store. Its local warehouse allows many Maryland customers to receive orders without the shipping delays common with distant retailers. The staff provides product consultation to help clients select appropriate items for their specific needs.

Customers include doctor’s offices, clinics, rehabilitation centers, nursing homes, assisted living communities, and physical therapy practices throughout Maryland and the surrounding area. The company also directs consumer referrals to a separate retail site, MedicalSupplySale.com.

The company emphasizes its local presence and trained showroom staff as key differentiators, aiming to simplify product selection for healthcare professionals and support independent living for patients. Its tagline, “Making Independent Living Easier…Since 1997,” reflects this mission.
